changes.summary: The signed order directs or conditionally authorizes mortgage-insurance cancellation, nationwide title-risk review and a 180-day factory-built-housing process; savings and housing-supply effects remain unmeasured.

changes.summary: The Section 232 proclamation directs Commerce and USTR to negotiate and report within 180 days but imposes no new wind-turbine tariff at this stage.

changes.summary: The notice would extend screening and prohibitions to more technologies and countries of concern; comments are due December 7 and no final rule has issued.

truth_social_media_inspection.finding: Eight new posts were reviewed as leads. Seven were text-only campaign or local commentary. Representative frames from the one video showed a basketball pregame lineup and overlaid commentary; audio and captions were not transcribed. No separate qualifying federal action was established.

trump_tv_inspection.finding: The official Trump TV and live pages retained stream A4gNgHfZ-v4. The dated video library still ended with four October 21 items and no October 22 upload. Titles, dates, durations and IDs were inspected; footage, audio and captions were unavailable. No qualifying new item was located in the material reviewed.
